plugin.note: Unlock Seeing red before expecting assignments. Adult and brutal Red dragons need dragonfire protection, while baby red dragons do not use dragonfire. Dragonbane ranged or melee is preferred; water spells exploit the 50% elemental weakness. Brutal red dragons can drop draconic visage but are slow compared to normal or baby red dragons.

requirements: Seeing red unlock for 50 Slayer reward points
Partial completion of Dragon Slayer I for the Anti-dragon shield
Dragonfire protection for adult and brutal red dragons
30 Agility for the Brimhaven Dungeon adult red dragon route
Dragon Slayer II for Corsair Cove Dungeon / Myths' Guild basement red dragons
Sacred Bone Burner unlock for the Forthos Dungeon bone-sacrifice method
mechanics: Adult red dragons attack with melee and dragonfire.
Brutal red dragons attack with melee, magic, and long-range dragonfire.
Baby red dragons do not attack with dragonfire.
The task page says Protect from Magic can suffice as a dragonfire protection alternative for adult and brutal variants.
The Red dragon monster page recommends anti-dragon shield and/or antifire potion, with antifire plus shield or super antifire giving full dragonfire protection.
Brutal red dragons can be fully protected from dragonfire and magic by using both Protect from Magic and an antifire potion.
Red dragons, baby red dragons, and brutal red dragons have a 50% elemental weakness to water spells.
Red dragons are dragons, so dragonbane weapons apply.
Elite Karamja Diary makes Brimhaven Dungeon red dragonhide drops noted.
Brutal red dragons can drop draconic visage but are a slow task option compared to normal or baby red dragons.

methods.label: Unlock and protection
methods.summary: Confirm Seeing red is unlocked, bring partial Dragon Slayer I dragonfire protection, and choose adult, baby, or brutal variants by speed and requirements.
prayers: Protect from Magic as a dragonfire alternative
Protect from Melee when using full dragonfire protection against adults
steps: Unlock Seeing red for 50 Slayer reward points before expecting Konar, Nieve, or Duradel Red dragon assignments.
Complete enough of Dragon Slayer I to receive the Anti-dragon shield.
Use dragonfire protection against adult and brutal red dragons.
Skip dragonfire gear only when intentionally killing baby red dragons.
Use dragonbane weapons where available, or water spells when exploiting the 50% elemental weakness.
risks: Adult and brutal red dragonfire can hit heavily without protection.
Protect from Magic alone leaves the player exposed to melee damage.

methods.label: Brimhaven adult cannon
methods.summary: Kill adult red dragons in Brimhaven Dungeon with cannon support and the pipe safespot, especially after Elite Karamja Diary.
steps: Use the Brimhaven Dungeon red dragon area after meeting the access requirements.
Set up a dwarf multicannon because the task page marks this location cannonable.
Use the safespot next to the pipe agility shortcut to the black demons when using Ranged or Magic.
Keep dragonfire protection active against adult red dragons.
After Elite Karamja Diary, prioritise this location when noted red dragonhide is useful.
notes: The task page lists 16 adult red dragons in Brimhaven Dungeon.

methods.label: Baby red dragons
methods.summary: Use baby red dragons for lower-risk kills because they do not use dragonfire and have lower Hitpoints.
requiredOrKeyItems: Dwarf multicannon for Brimhaven or Corsair Cove
Dragon Slayer II for Corsair Cove baby red dragons
steps: Choose baby red dragons when speed and safety matter more than adult red dragonhide and bones.
Do not reserve inventory space for dragonfire protection solely for baby red dragons because they do not use dragonfire.
Use Brimhaven Dungeon if cannoning before Dragon Slayer II, accepting nearby adult red dragon and wild dog pressure.
Use Corsair Cove Dungeon after Dragon Slayer II for two bank-adjacent baby red dragons.
Avoid Forthos baby red dragons when cannon or safespot support is required because the task page marks them as neither.
notes: The Baby red dragon page says they are weak to ranged, magic, and stab attacks.

methods.label: Forthos adult safespot
methods.summary: Use Forthos Dungeon when safespotting adults and using local altar, bone, hide, and Crafting utility.
requiredOrKeyItems: Needle and Thread or Costume needle
steps: Use the safespot next to the fire and stalagmite near the strange floor agility shortcut.
Use the nearby altar to sustain Prayer Points indefinitely.
After unlocking the Sacred Bone Burner, sacrifice dragon bones there for bonus XP.
Bring a Needle and Thread or Costume needle to craft hides tanned with Eodan for Crafting XP.
Use water spells or dragonbane ranged when avoiding melee range.

methods.label: Corsair Cove bank route
methods.summary: After Dragon Slayer II, use Corsair Cove Dungeon / Myths' Guild basement for a bank-adjacent group of adult and baby red dragons.
recommendedFor: mixed adult and baby red dragon kills
requiredOrKeyItems: Dragonfire protection for adult red dragons
steps: Use this method only after Dragon Slayer II.
Kill the three adult red dragons and two baby red dragons near the bank.
Use dragonfire protection when attacking adult red dragons.
Bank dragon bones and red dragonhide when profit matters more than continuous kills.
notes: The task page explicitly calls this group very close to a bank.

methods.label: Brutal red dragons
methods.summary: Kill Brutal red dragons only when intentionally choosing the slower Catacombs alternative with draconic visage chance.
steps: Use Catacombs of Kourend for the three Brutal red dragon spawns.
Use both Protect from Magic and an antifire potion to fully protect from their magic and long-range dragonfire attacks.
Avoid standing in melee range when safespotting.
Use dragonbane ranged or melee, or water spells for the 50% elemental weakness.
Choose this method only when the draconic visage chance or Catacombs drops justify the slower task.
risks: The task page says Brutal red dragons are generally not worth killing because they are slow compared to normal or baby red dragons.

styleOptions.label: Dragonbane ranged
styleOptions.summary: Use dragon hunter crossbow or another strong ranged weapon for adult, baby, or brutal red dragon kills.

styleOptions.label: Dragonbane melee
styleOptions.summary: Use dragon hunter lance or stab melee with dragonfire protection for adult dragons.

styleOptions.label: Water magic
styleOptions.summary: Use water spells or dragon hunter wand to exploit the 50% water weakness from range.
